description: Get the exact commands for running the local crypto plane (the `@seekrit/mcp` npm server, the `@seekrit/cli` CLI, seekrit-run, seekrit-proxy), including a copy-paste .mcp.json that reuses this session's credential. Takes no arguments and returns prose plus config. Call this the moment you need to SET or READ a secret value — no tool on this server will ever return one. Use local_tool_for instead when you want the single command for one named operation.
name: setup_local_crypto
